description.narrative: The #AcceleratorLab team from North Macedonia has been established in October 2020, and since then has worked as a team within the UNDP country office. Within these two years, the team has integrated within the UNDP country office, working on numerous projects and activities alongside our portfolios, as well as processes that we have designed-developed and implemented individually. The Lab is working on system transformation for the public sector both on the national and local levels, exploring

2.2 - At least 50% of our learning challenges have the public sector or other partner as counterpart. Together with the City of Skopje and as part of the winning Green Shark Challenge application establish a biohacking laboratory that is open to the public and will contribute to bringing science closer to the community of entrepreneurs. It will enable the design of durable solutions for complex environmental challenges, and it will foster innovation, education, and meaningful engagement of communities around the country. The Initiative will focus on biowaste as an entry point in creating entrepreneurial opportunities for a greener future that can be scaled up across the country and region.
Dream Labs – National institutions in North Macedonia The Government of North Macedonia adopted the proposed methodological approach co-designed by UNDP as the guiding principles behind developing the NDS. The methodology also envisions the Dream Labs as a method of engaging citizens in the visioning process of the NDS, but also as a monitoring and implementation mechanism. Thus far the Dream Labs have been organized by UNDP but also other societal actors, including national institutions. DPPD – Financial Management at local governments – the study looked at financial and managerial practices of all of the municipalities based on the datasets from the “Open finance” initiative. The selected positive deviants in the study worked with us to determine the factors of the success, and we where able to do a qualitative data collection on the underlying practices that lead to success. Document Management Systems – Together with Ministry of Information Society and Administration we co-create the digital solution for the system that aims to remove the paper from the public institutions. DMS has been enrolled in one phase at some of the ministries, and one municipality. The 10 institutions provided experiences from the system and insights on how the co-creation of the digital solution would look like.
. 2.3 - At least one government entity or partner has adopted an accelerator lab method. The City of Skopje has accepted that the Bio-hacking Lab can serve as aco-creation and open space for opening up science methods to the larger ecosystem of climate scientists. The methods of working of the labaratory were defined using portfolio approach and acclabs methods such as: 1. Bio waste thematic focus – as this initiative is part of a bio-waste circularity portfolio, the lab should allow for activities with thematic focus around bio-waste 2. Fixed “home” – the local ecosystem responds particularly well to the concept of “hubs” – dedicated physical spaces for specific activities that become the place where something happens and a community of interested parties revolve around these physical hubs 3. Active learning space – the biohacking lab is not a library of static content, but a place of experimentation and learning through doing. 4. Open and accessible – the lab should provide access to amateur and semi-professional equipment that could be used by people of different level of knowledge and skills (with guidance) 5. Modular – allowing gradual scaling, starting with a functional MVP, and adding component parts as needed or as funds become available 6. Community-run (eventually) The aspiration is to arrive at a point where the lab is community run; Dream Labs. The Dream Labs are an idea that has been developed by multiple stakeholders involved in the #NDS process. They are an integral part of the methodology that the institutions and UNDP uses to build and formulate the Development Strategy. The national institutions have not only joined Dream Labs as participants, but they have also been a part of the design process, and they some of the Labs are co-organized by them. One example is the co-organized Dream Labs between UN[DP] and the Macedonian Academy of Arts and Sciences. Document Management System: Acc Lab team lead the co-creation of the digital user journey and service blueprint of the digital product. Together with the Ministry of Information Society and Administration, and 10 other public institutions that where part of the first phase of the DMS we worked together to design the layout of the service, functionalities, as well as processes in digital space.
2.4 - At least 50% of our learning challenges are providing actionable knowledge to ongoing CO projects. Actionable Intelligence for the entire country - Impact Assessment of the Multi-dimensional studies = The multi-dimensional crisis worsened the socio-economic situation in North Macedonia. To assess the impact of these crisis the Accelerator Labs alongside the UNDP country office portfolios commissioned the development of two research studies, one on the impact of the crisis on local governments, and the other on the price and availability of commodities in the food and energy sectors. Both studies have informed our arguments, and proposed policies throughout 2022.
- Fridays@theLab offered a designated space to the CO colleagues where they could learn, ideate and design interventions. Thought the year we had 40 Fridays where the colleagues participated in the guest presentations, presentations from other teams, discussion sessions, and/or reading insights on various topics. In 2022 the month of March was completely designated to raising actionable intelligence on Gender Issues. Governance: - DPPD : The study was able to combine both big data and qualitative analysis on the practices at local goverments. The learnings form these practices where grouped on three main categories: people and HR related practices, System and processes in place, as well as the tools used by the officers in charge for the financial management. The study point out few area that are replicable across to the other municipalities. - Dream Labs The Dream Labs as a tool provide community actionable intelligence to the country office. The Labs allow for UNDP to interact with citizens, institutions, civil society sector and academia on future –oriented processes, utilizing the Dream Labs as its foresight community tool. Environment: Water + Heat Through the Accelerator Lab water initiative, we provided actionable intelligence to the country office using rapid ethnographic research to learn more about sustainable water management practices. We also gave the country office insights into how we can involve citizens in a crowd-mapping exercise to map the public fountains in the city of Skopje, as well as gathered data that is of use to our country office, but also our national institutions. The Accelerator Lab also provided actionable intelligence to the office on ‘Chief Heat Officers’ by organizing a public debate about this policy innovation, and what we can learn from it, and embed in our city resilience projects. - Nudges The learning goal was to help local CSOs to improve their skills in creating more accurate behavioral interventions that match identified barriers, drivers, and decision situations; The intervention was done together with a project from the Environmental portfolio that has a goal to tackle air pollution in the city and consisted of designing the learning space, finding the right experts and CSO that can implement such behaviour nudges. Inclusive prosperity: -Smart Specialization (Igor) Using the ongoing Smart Specialization Strategy process, the Acceleration labs was able to give actionable intelligence to the three portfolios around innovation policy concept to support regional prioritization in innovative sectors, fields, or technologies through the entrepreneurial discovery process (EDP), a bottom-up approach to reveal what a region does best in terms of its scientific and technological endowments. - Biowaste (Igor) The transformation potential of biowaste was included in the offer of the Inclusive prosperity Unit towards the private sector. The benefits of the workshops conducted in Tetovo, Skopje and Strumica in order to acquaint food processors, retail food sector and consumers with the possibilities of applying the circular economy and the valorization processes of the biowaste for obtaining bioproducts at the national level.

Our support for the development of the National Development Strategy has the government [the Deputy Prime Ministers of North Macedonia] has the government as a partner in the process as well as other UN agencies, and the donor community. The support for the development of the NDS, is a part of our first frontier challenge #Governance #GoodGovernance, and our learning question on how we can redesign our public policy process. In City Experiment Fund we have created partnerships with the academia, private sector and civil society organization. We have been working on close partnership with other UN agencies in few activities ( SDG tool piloting for the stateless in partnership with UNHCR, Green Shark Challenge in partnership with UNICEF). Together with private sector partners we implemented Accelerate 2030 program in North Macedonia, where two startups made it to global program showcasing their work on the SDGs. 2.3 - At least one government entity or partner has adopted an accelerator lab method. The Accelerator Lab team had the opportunity to support the Democratic Governance unit within our Country office in a process aimed at supporting the development of a National Development Strategy in our country. Within the National Development Strategy process, UNDPs key partners [national institutions] have adopted [through a session of a Steering Board Committee] the methodological approach that we have proposed to be followed for the development of the NDS. Namely, the methodological approach, co-created in a process including national institutions, CSOs, experts the UNDP country office and other entities has used the Doughnut model of economics as a method of mapping risks and identifying areas where we need to build capabilities in our society. The methodology also adopts a more flexible, learning oriented, humble approach to policymaking that relies on iterations and experimentation. This is something that we believe is closely aligned with the #AccLab method of work. 2.4 - At least 50% of our learning challenges are providing actionable knowledge to ongoing CO projects. #GoodGovernance, giving actionable knowledge to our Democratic Governance Unit #SluggishEconomy, giving actionable knowledge to our Environment Unit on circularity, and our Inclusive Prosperity Unit on new jobs and skills.

The Recursive, an independent community-born online media focused on the emerging tech and startup ecosystems in Southeast Europe (SEE), writes about the Accelerate2030 program https://therecursive.com/accelerate2030-to-help-macedonian-startups-develop-and-scale-sustainable-solutions/ UN RCO MK with a story around Youth in Macedonia as a driving force in the SDG forefillment. / overview on how the Accelerate 2030 program can help impact driven startups can their solutions using UNs global network https://northmacedonia.un.org/en/143226-lead-way-youth-north-macedonia-are-driving-progress-sdgs Local financial magazine about the launch of the Accelerate2030 program https://pari.com.mk/accelerate2030-seavus/ Macedonian News –aggregator time.mk quick search on all the articles around the Launch of the Accelerate2030 program https://time.mk/c/13d272ae15/undp-seavus-akcelerator-i-biznis-impakt-lab-zapocnuvaat-sorabotka-za-sproveduvanje-na-programata-accelerate2030.html The publication/blogpost Fridays at the Lab has been shared by a key startup entity on their social media. The startup Challenger has been a part of the Fridays at the Lab sessions and has thus shared this content, because it showcased their participation in our UNDP country office. Our accelerator Lab team was invited to take part in the E-society.mk international conference, to talk about our approach of learning and working, and our participation to that event, as well as our talking points has been reshared on the social media pages of the Metamorphosis foundation [one of the key CSOs in our country when talking about digitalization and open data]. The publication/blogpost Ground Control to Major Tom has been shared by the UNHCR social media platforms in our country right after being published on the UNDP mk website and social media. The UNHCR social media platform has a different ecosystem and target groups, so it is a noteworthy example of expanding our ecosystem in reach. The office of the President of the Republic of North Macedonia issued a statement pertaining the development of the National Development Strategy (url: https://pretsedatel.mk/en/harmonized-unique-approach-to-drafting-a-document-for-long-term-development-strategy-of-the-republic-of-north-macedonia/)

The Lab was established at the end of 2020, the last member being on board on the 23rd of November. This did not allow much time for the lab to work towards the targets set for year 1. Based on the 100 days Action Plan and activities the Lab completed the followings can be outlined: 1.1. 2 new sources of date have been introduced (Global Entrepreneurship Index, Challenger application data presented at the Friday@the Lab) 1.2. 1 ethnographic research and data set collected from Old Bazar, and Suto Orizare 1.3. Solutions mapping: Open Agenda, Visualization of Strategies, Go-green, Turistico, NaTocak, bulk waste separation, Incentives/gamification for using alternative means of transport 1.4. Two innovation methods used per country LAB (co-design and future thinking and sense making) 2.1 one blog post published 4th of December 2.2 Governance learning challenge, National Development Strategy - public sector as a partner. 4 Deputy Prime Ministers a part of the Steering Committee of the process, City of Skopje 2.3 Co-design workshop was held with the ministry of Economy, and Ministry of Environment 2.4 NDS – feeds in directly to the Governance program in the CO 3.1 13 interactions with other LABs (Serbia, Bosna and Herzegovina, India, Georgia, Kyrgyzstan, Saudi Arabia, Mexico, Ukraine, Turkey, Belarus, El Salvador, Panama) 3.2 Blog posts on System transformation highlight the knowledge of different methodologies that we have been exploring, and sharing with the outer network. 3.3 One per month in December and January, and more then two times in February, 2021 Team actively engages in LinkedIn and initiates discussions with the ecosystems at least once in a week.
